description: The loan-to-value ratio is the loan balance divided by the property's value, shown as a percent, and this tool computes LTV, combined LTV (CLTV) with other liens, and the equity cushion behind a note. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

other_liens.description: Balances of other liens on the property, USD. Default 0.

name: loan_to_value
title: Loan-to-value (LTV) ratio calculator
